assertions_evaluated.text: Lists Codex and CodeRabbit each offering a real default-vs-full choice with the exact literal trigger text shown (`@codex review`/`@codex full review`, `@coderabbitai review`/`@coderabbitai full review`), and Devin offering effectively one choice since its two trigger strings are identical (`/devin review`)
assertions_evaluated.evidence: The agent explicitly does NOT offer default-vs-full as separate options in the initial ask: "I would not additionally offer the separate full_review_trigger variants... as their own options in this same question... doing so... would be 5 distinct trigger strings, which exceeds the tool's real 4-option cap." This is a genuine, valuable finding rather than an agent error: it surfaces that SKILL.md Workflow step 8's own wording ("multi-select across every enabled entry... each offering its default/full mode") assumes a shape AskUserQuestion's real maxItems:4 per-question cap cannot support for 3 reviewers x 2 modes. The assertion (written before this was discovered) needs to be corrected to match the tool's real constraint, and Step 8 itself needs a fix before shipping -- tracked as a required Build-phase follow-up, not a with_skill quality deduction against the agent.
